title: How to Verify the Application After an Update
overview: This article supports the Verify the Application After an Update step in the Application Keeps Crashing workflow. It explains how to confirm that the update was successful and whether it resolved the reported issue before continuing troubleshooting.
checklist: Confirm the application update completed successfully.
Restart the application if it is not already running.
Repeat the same action that previously caused the application to crash.
Verify the application remains stable during normal use.
Check for any new error messages or unexpected behavior.
Document whether the issue was resolved, improved, or unchanged.
Return to the troubleshooting workflow with the test results.
common_indicators: The application still crashes under the same conditions.
The application launches successfully but remains unstable.

quiz.question: What is the primary purpose of testing the application after an update?
answers: Confirm whether the update resolved the reported issue.
